residualCounterexample.conclusion: zero residual cannot identify the ground state

admissionRequirements: sector-valid Ritz vectors supply variational upper bounds U_even and U_odd
each lower bound L_sector must use a validated enclosure theorem with every premise recorded
residual proximity alone is rejected because it does not label the eigenvalue
Temple-Kato is admitted only with a certified next-eigenvalue lower bound beta greater than the target Rayleigh quotient
Lehmann bounds are admitted only with their separating shift or neighbouring-eigenvalue information independently certified
inertia is admitted only when the shifted factorization or equivalent eigenvalue count is itself validated
the parity gap interval is [L_odd-U_even, U_odd-L_even] and is positive only if L_odd>U_even
